task_title: G2-A: Add deterministic equipment placeholders and art-key manifest

plan_review.notes: Concern 1 (blocking): placeholder briefId used dotted artKey which does not normalize the same way as art-plan kebab IDs — fixed by using artKey.replace(dots,hyphens) as briefId throughout (gen-placeholders.ts, helper functions, tests). Concern 2 (non-blocking): integration.id overloaded to link back to manifest — fixed by removing integration fields from YAML plans entirely (they have no runtime targets yet). Concern 3 (non-blocking): no cross-manifest sync guard — fixed by adding 3 new tests verifying every JSON entry appears in exactly one plan and vice versa. Concern 4 (suggestion): runtimeKey contract wording — clarified in helper function JSDoc comment. plan_divergence=minor: blocking fix changed briefId convention but no re-architecture; the manifest-first design stood.
